commit.message:
fix(docs): mark Qwen3/Qwen3.5 VLM CP as supported, drop stale 'Other HF' row (#3749)

**What**
- README Models-support table: CP for Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 VLMs was listed as
not supported (red cross) — changed to supported.
- Removed the stale 'Other HF causal LMs' row from the README table.
- Updated the same Qwen VLM CP claim in docs/advanced.md for
consistency.

**Why it's true**
CP works for the Qwen VLMs since #3099 (CP for hybrid + VLM SFT) and
#3103 (pack multimodal samples with CP): Qwen3_5ForCausalLM is the
unified class for the qwen3_5 / qwen3_5_moe VLM configs, cp_support()
returns ring + ulysses for them, and image grids / positions are sharded
under CP.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Documentation-only changes to support matrices; no runtime or config
behavior is modified.
> 
> **Overview**
> Updates the **Models support** tables in `README.md` and
`docs/advanced.md` so **Qwen3 / Qwen3.5 VLMs** show **context
parallelism (CP) as supported** (✅), replacing the outdated ❌ that no
longer matches trainer behavior after recent CP + multimodal work.
> 
> The README also **drops the “Other HF causal LMs” row**, which was
redundant/stale relative to the family-specific table above it.
>
